claude_code.reproducible_by: anyone with a Claude subscription and this CLI build
claude_code.decoding_note: The CLI exposes no temperature/top_p/max_tokens controls; nulls record that these were NOT pinned rather than claiming a setting the run did not make. The thinking budget IS controllable and is pinned to 0 via env: measured 2026-09-05, the default budget spent up to 7,223 thinking tokens on a single triple extraction (46-61s/case), against 0 thinking / 145 output tokens / 1.7s for the identical extraction with the budget off.
